metadata.positive_pair_trigger: trigger of later record finalization; not direct retrieval or causal attribution
metadata.operation_trigger: claim_on_arrival/claim_at_deadline requires immediately preceding same-time claim NEW for the merge representative and target issue; raw triggers are also retained
metadata.wrong_operation: directed source record and scoring representative
metadata.gold_assumption: cross-component negatives use the frozen workflow closed-world proxy
metadata.support_limitation: same-source and shared-stratum supports are policy-dependent, nonrandom, descriptive sensitivity analyses
metadata.uncertainty: one-stream analyses are descriptive; no independent-pair tests or p-values
metadata.source: corrected causal replay, six frozen policies
